audience: allied health practice managers who run scheduling and billing in splose

useCases.title: Find open slots and review practitioner working hours
useCases.text: The AI finds open slots for one or more practitioners at a location for a service, within a window of up to 7 days. It can also read a practitioner's working-hours roster.

useCases.title: Review the appointments in a time window
useCases.text: The AI lists appointments filtered by time window, practitioner or status, with service, location, price and status such as Arrived or Cancelled.

useCases.title: List practitioners, locations and services
useCases.text: The AI lists the staff with profession and online-booking flag, the practice locations, and the service catalogue with duration and price.

useCases.title: Find invoices that are awaiting payment
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices with status Awaiting Payment, with issue and due dates, total and paid amount, so you see what is owed, oldest first.

useCases.title: Check blocked-out time in practitioner calendars
useCases.text: The AI lists busy times such as leave and admin time, with start and end, location and practitioners, so you can plan around them.

useCases.title: Record a payment against an invoice
useCases.text: The AI checks what is owed on an invoice and records one payment with a payment method. This does not charge a card, and the amount cannot exceed what is owed.
